Messages.Author: prunesquallor
Messages.Body:
It doesn't help with spamming corruption counters, but I have used Mental Maze to good effect in some (not very good) Settite or Baali blocking decks.

The difficulty with Revelations of Despair is that there's very little else available that can put corruption counters on your predator, so it's your only mechanism. There is Cagliostro, Weigh the Heart, and some anarch card or another which can put counters on players other than your prey, but those are all pretty hard to do.

I wish there were a card that would allow putting a corruption counter on a minion that already has one of your corruption counters. Perhaps
+1 stealth action
Put a corruption counter on a minion controlled by your prey. Boilerplate corruption counter text goes here.
Put a corruption counter on a minion who already has one of your corruption counters.

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
I tried using Revelation of Despair once. I found it wasn't entirely bad, because you could cycle it at basic for some benefit against bigcap vampires that you'll never get to steal. against allies and weenies, I used it for the corruption counters. it usually scared them into not taking actions anymore.

it wasn't an awesome strategy, but kinda fun to have that choice.
